habitat: Tropical lowland rainforest; primary lowland forests; and plantations below 500 m
story: The Sabah Partridge (Tropicoperdix graydoni) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Phasianidae family. It is most commonly observed in Tropical lowland rainforest; primary lowland forests; and plantations below 500 m, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Near Threatened (NT) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Sabah Partridge is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Sabah Partridge into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
